historical_projects.title: Automated Brain Tumor Detection via CNN
key_bottlenecks: Data preprocessing & annotation took 6 extra days due to unbalanced slices
historical_projects.lessons_learned: Allocate at least 30% of total project time to data quality and validation.

historical_projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications
key_bottlenecks: Feature engineering validation across skewed demographic records
historical_projects.lessons_learned: Automated feature importance checks saved 4 days during iteration.

historical_projects.title: Decentralized Campus Resource Sharing Platform
key_bottlenecks: Authentication & role-based permission sync between backend and frontend state
historical_projects.lessons_learned: Contract-first OpenAPI mocking prevents UI blocking while backend is in progress.

historical_projects.title: Smart Agricultural Moisture & Micro-climate Monitoring
key_bottlenecks: Hardware sensor calibration drift and packet loss in mesh network
historical_projects.lessons_learned: Always test hardware in simulated field noise prior to review 1.

historical_projects.title: Comparative Study on Transformer Quantization Methods
key_bottlenecks: Inconsistent benchmark suites and statistical significance convergence
historical_projects.lessons_learned: Pre-script reproducible seeds before running matrix evaluations.

criteria.name: Problem Formulation & Objectives
criteria.description: Clear problem statement, research/engineering motivation, scope boundaries, and measurable success metrics.

criteria.name: Literature Review & Prior Art
criteria.description: Comprehensive comparative survey of existing methodologies, citing peer-reviewed benchmarks.

criteria.name: System Architecture & Design
criteria.description: Sound modular design, data flow diagrams, schema design, and technical trade-off justification.

criteria.name: Methodology & Implementation
criteria.description: High code quality, execution of ML models or backend services, algorithmic correctness.

criteria.name: Rigorous Evaluation & Testing
criteria.description: Ablation tests, confusion matrix, F1/accuracy metrics, unit & integration test coverage.

criteria.name: Documentation & Viva Presentation
criteria.description: Comprehensive final report adhering to academic formatting guidelines and structured presentation slides.
